_comment: Crop boxes [left, top, right, bottom] in source pixels. Source paths are relative to video/assets/raw/. Output goes to video/assets/shots/<name>.png, which the compositions show unchanged. To swap a screenshot, replace the raw file (or point 'source' at a new one), fix the box, and rerun crop_shots.py. questionnaire: live app session data/processed/app/20261115-150339-story-ia; progress, comparison, checks, qa: live app session data/processed/app/20261115-190206-story-ia (GPT-6 Luna, Story County IA, same settings, light mode, 1600 px wide).
